title: Constructible subobject presentation on a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. There exist a small filtered category $A$ of universe $u+1$, a diagram $D:A\to\operatorname{Sheaf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\operatorname{Mod}\Lambda)$, and a natural transformation $\iota:D\to\operatorname{const}(F)$ such that each $D(a)$ is constructible [def-constructible-constructible], every $\iota_a$ is a monomorphism, and $(F,\iota)$ is a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. No torsion, curve, field or properness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 03SA(3) (lemma-colimit-constructible), 09BH(3) (proposition-constructible-noetherian), and 03SC, first proof paragraph; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03SA, /09BH and /03SC

proof.text: Apply lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaf-colimit-constructible to obtain a filtered constructible module-sheaf diagram D with cocone ι and vertex F. Noetherian schemes are qcqs. Convert the diagram objects to the source IsConstructibleSheaf predicate using lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison.

Replace D(a) by image(ι_a). Use Mathlib image.map on the square with left edge D(φ) and right edge id_F. Cancellation against the monic image inclusions and image.map_homMk'_ι proves the identity and composition laws. The inclusions ε_a:image(ι_a)→F are natural, and image.factor_map makes factorThruImage(ι_a) into a natural transformation π:D→E.

The finite ring Λ is Noetherian. The kernel inclusion ker(ι_a)→D(a) is mono, so lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-subobject-noetherian makes its source constructible. Apply the cokernel clause of thm-constructible-serre to this inclusion. Transfer constructibility through Mathlib Abelian.coimageIsoImage' to image(ι_a).

For a cocone s on E, compose its legs with π to obtain a cocone on D and use the original colimit descent map F→s.pt. Cancel the epimorphism factorThruImage(ι_a) to prove that this descent restricts to s on E(a). For uniqueness, use the original colimit hom_ext after factoring each ι_a through its image and applying the assumed equalities on ε_a. This proves the actual cocone colimit universal property, not merely an isomorphism of vertices.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_filtered_colimit_constructible_subobjects
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    ∃ (A : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory A) (_ : IsFiltered A)
      (D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
      (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj F),
      (∀ a, IsConstructibleSheaf (D.obj a)) ∧
      (∀ a, Mono (ι.app a)) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F ι))
